subject: session date
fact: The session occurs on the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493 DR.
source_quote: On the 5th day of the 2nd Tenday of Taraskh 1493

subject: elapsed time
fact: An hour passes between two events in the session.
source_quote: An hour later

subject: chasme count
fact: Four chasme demons are present in the cavern above the prisoners' tower.
source_quote: four chasme and two vrock

subject: travel to Sloobludop
fact: Sloobludop is approximately eight days away via the Darklake.
source_quote: the town of Sloopdopblop is just eight days away

subject: Velkynvelve elevation
fact: Velkynvelve sits 100 feet above the cavern floor.
source_quote: Drow outpost was 100' in the sky

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Zalthir's trial of the broken mirror
fact: Zalthir skipped the third breath, bled ki into fingertips, and arrived three seconds faster than the Grandmaster, despite technically violating every scroll.
source_quote: You skip the third breath. You don't enter your ki in the hara. You let it bleed into your fingertips like a poison. It is technically wrong in every scroll. And yet, you arrived at your destination three seconds faster than the Grandmaster did.

subject: Glabbagool's prisoner training
fact: Glabbagool became a better monk by watching the spy — patience under provocation, stillness amid hostility, responding to aggression without being ruled by it.
source_quote: Will I be more of a monk or less of a monk by watching her? Is this some kind of pre-monk training you've put me in?

subject: Candlekeep's prisoner policy
fact: Candlekeep holds prisoners but does not keep them — they are delayed, not jailed, and eventually released with a warning.
source_quote: We hold prisoners. We do not keep them. If you give her to us, what you are giving us is a delay.

subject: Echoing Hall
fact: The Echoing Hall returns sound slightly altered — not an echo, but as if the library itself were taking notes.
source_quote: Stone corridors in Candlekeep's north inner ward have a habit of returning sound to you slightly altered — not an echo exactly, more like the library itself was taking notes.

subject: Khell-Vire's note
fact: The note on Khell-Vire's desk reads: 'Zalthir, the Underdark, until the Bone King sings.'
source_quote: Zalthir, the Underdark, until the Bone King sings.

subject: Zalthir's failed demonstration
fact: Zalthir failed the Weightless Shadow, Efficient Strike, and Eldritch Claw by adhering to survival-based Underdark practice rather than formal monk form.
source_quote: The corridor was narrow. The form was irrelevant. Did you not practice your forms while traveling?

subject: the monk's final question
fact: The blind monk asked Zalthir: 'Show me what else you haven't learned.'
source_quote: Show me what else you haven't learned.

subject: Thorin's observation on Glabbagool
fact: Thorin observed that Glabbagool seemed ambivalent about his role as prisoner watcher.
source_quote: Thorin observed that Glabbagool seemed ambivalent.

subject: Zalthir's response to the monk
fact: Zalthir asked whether he could punch the monk — and did.
source_quote: Zalthir asked whether he could punch the monk.

subject: the spy's demand
fact: The spy demanded to be formally jailed by Candlekeep, treating imprisonment as a right she had never before had to argue for.
source_quote: She announced that she was a prisoner and wished to be formally jailed by Candlekeep's guards.

subject: Candlekeep's entrance
fact: Candlekeep is a dark stack of towers against the sky, impossible to mistake, visible from miles out.
source_quote: Candlekeep is visible from miles out — a dark stack of towers against the sky, impossible to mistake.

subject: Daz's silence
fact: Daz went quiet beside Zalthir, hand going to his temple — the first sign the madness from the Underdark had not stopped at the surface.
source_quote: Daz went quiet beside me somewhere around the second hour of walking. Not his usual quiet. His hand went to his temple and stayed there.

subject: the First Reader's reaction to the spy
fact: The First Reader looked at the spy with something that might have been sympathy and explained the decision was not hers.
source_quote: The First Reader looked at her with something that might have been sympathy and explained that as a guest of Candlekeep — as a member, technically, of our adventuring party — the decision was ours, not hers.

subject: Grygum's summary of the situation
fact: Grygum summarized the containment breach as: 'We've been caught.'
source_quote: We've been caught.

subject: Khell-Vire's philosophy
fact: Khell-Vire said: 'I will not be there. This is your work, not mine.'
source_quote: I will not be there. This is your work, not mine.

subject: Zalthir's reflection on shadow monk pedagogy
fact: Zalthir said: 'I've played this game before, my friends,' referencing five centuries of shadow monk tradition.
source_quote: I've played this game before, my friends

subject: Thorin's final question
fact: Thorin asked: 'Can he attack him while he's walking away? Blindside him, as it were?'
source_quote: Can he attack him while he's walking away? Blindside him, as it were?

subject: Zalthir's roll
fact: Zalthir rolled a 30 to hit the monk as he walked away.
source_quote: I mean, I rolled a 30 to hit. Does that get me anything?

subject: the monastery's class on postponements
fact: Brother Ferrath or Brother Aldas taught a class on the difference between solutions and postponements — Zalthir remembers nothing else but wanting to be in the training hall.
source_quote: There was a class at the monastery — I think it was Brother Ferrath, or possibly Brother Aldas, I'm genuinely uncertain — on the difference between solutions and postponements.

subject: Zalthir's realization about the chant
fact: Zalthir knows the chant — he knows what the scholar was doing wrong, and the specific wrongness of it — the way he syncopated his breath against the syllables — was not a beginner's error.
source_quote: I know that chant. I know it well enough to know what he was doing wrong, and the specific wrongness of it — the way he syncopated his breath against the syllables, or tried to — was not a beginner's error.

subject: Eldred's pattern
fact: Eldred had the same pattern — the man who went insane. The Field Ward Preacher had it too.
source_quote: Eldred had it, earlier in the journey — the man who went insane. The Field Ward Preacher had it too.

subject: Candlekeep's bell tower
fact: Candlekeep's bell tower has cells — comfortable, localized anti-magic — rarely used.
source_quote: The bell tower has cells. Comfortable, localized anti-magic. They are very rarely used.

subject: the spy's fury
fact: The spy was furious when told she could not be formally jailed — she had opinions. Several of them.
source_quote: The spy was furious. She turned to Kalan and announced that she was a prisoner and wished to be formally jailed by Candlekeep's guards.

subject: Zalthir's final assessment
fact: Zalthir concluded: 'It was. Patience under provocation. Maintaining stillness when the environment is actively hostile. Responding to aggression without being ruled by it.'
source_quote: It was. Patience under provocation. Maintaining stillness when the environment is actively hostile. Responding to aggression without being ruled by it.

subject: Thorin's peace
fact: Thorin came back in with the settled look of a man who had had a thought that satisfied him. 'Life takes you in weird directions and weird places,' he said. 'You just gotta go with it.'
source_quote: Life takes you in weird directions and weird places," he said. "You just gotta go with it.

subject: Zalthir's meditation
fact: Zalthir climbed to the roof to meditate. He came back down later, settled. The expression of someone closing an internal argument, not opening an external one.
source_quote: Zalthir climbed to the roof to meditate. He came back down later, settled. The expression of someone closing an internal argument, not opening an external one.

subject: the wall remembers
fact: The soot mark on the south wall sat where it always sat. The floor, scrubbed every season. The wall remembers.
source_quote: The soot mark on the south wall sat where it always sat. The floor, scrubbed every season. The wall remembers.

subject: the scholar's chant
fact: The young human scholar recited a chant under his breath — rhythmic, almost liturgical — and the pattern was wrong by a hair, in a way that took actual knowledge of the correct version to notice.
source_quote: There was a young human scholar in the far corner — not a human scholar, a *young* human scholar, because those are meaningfully different things and I did not want to get the category wrong — who was reciting something under his breath. A chant of some kind. Rhythmic, almost liturgical.
